name: @stigmer/coding-agent-plugin
description: Stigmer's plugin for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor): a skill that answers questions about Stigmer from its live docs, the guide that sets Stigmer up for a project, the bundled stigmer mcp-server and a guard that asks before what can't be undone, published at the CLI's own version so `stigmer coding-agent` prints the guide its CLI follows
